people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”
translations.bsb: “Not so, my father!” Joseph said. “This one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
translations.asv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father; for this is the first-born; put thy right hand upon his head.
